name: career-radar
description: Evidence-based career decision support as a ChatGPT plugin.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @career-radar/shared build && pnpm --filter @career-radar/web build && pnpm --filter @career-radar/server build
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter @career-radar/shared build && pnpm --filter @career-radar/web build && pnpm --filter @career-radar/server demo
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @career-radar/shared build && pnpm --filter @career-radar/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @career-radar/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @career-radar/server typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @career-radar/shared build && pnpm --filter @career-radar/web build && pnpm -r --if-present test
